rca of the issue: Previous basis was sum(lot_size)+sum(risk_pct)+count — a mutation preserving totals (BUY XAUUSD 1.0/1% -> SELL EURUSD 1.0/1%) kept basis unchanged so read_state served stale per-symbol/side exposure. Fix: replace sums with sha256 of sorted per-position (_id + normalized risk-affecting fields) tuples; also add day_closed group to catch closed_at moves that shift daily loss without altering weekly total. Verified: primary tests + independent one-write probe both show 'recomputed' on composition change and 'maintained' on re-read.
